FN-YYFY6N-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 158
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/25/2023
Senate Bill 158 as introduced would expand the notifications required to be provided by a judge
of probate to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA), for inclusion into the State
firearms prohibited persons database, for individuals involuntarily admitted for outpatient
treatment.
According to ALEA, this could increase the obligations of ALEA, by an undetermined amount,
to modify the current state firearms prohibited person database to comply with the provisions of
this bill.
